design: Two color-swapped games, standard start. Both use Stockfish MultiPV=3, identical node budgets, Threads=1, Hash=16, cleared per turn. Jev only selects among cp candidates within margin; no scores/ranks/base/PVs sent. Node limits may overshoot. Jev adds API time; not an equal-wall-time comparison. Shortlisting is engine assistance, not independent chess reasoning.
